property_summary: For every call to sendTo by the owner with a non-zero receiver and positive amount, the reference contract either delivers the amount or reverts on failing delivery; specifically, when the receiver's fallback reverts, the reference call itself always reverts (ok==false) while the mutant that uses send() may return ok==true — therefore the property: calling sendTo on a receiver that reverts must not complete successfully (ok == false) for all inputs.
change_summary: Change the transfer call to send, which returns false instead of reverting on failure (so behavior on failure differs).
